subject.title: fix(macos): PortGuardian opens current shared state databases

question: Does redacted after-fix macOS runtime evidence show PortGuardian safely opening a Node-upgraded schema-v5 shared database while retaining fail-closed handling for newer versions?
rationale: Unit fixtures and CI validate the implementation boundary but cannot demonstrate the actual native PortGuardian startup path against a Node-upgraded shared database on macOS.

options.title: Request live macOS proof
options.body: Require a redacted terminal transcript or runtime log showing PortGuardian opening a Node-upgraded v5 database and rejecting a v6 fixture before merge.

options.title: Accept fixture-only evidence
options.body: Accept the existing version-matrix tests and CI as sufficient proof for this native compatibility boundary.

recommendation.title: Request live macOS proof
recommendation.body: Require a redacted terminal transcript or runtime log showing PortGuardian opening a Node-upgraded v5 database and rejecting a v6 fixture before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The assigned implementer is best positioned to provide the real macOS runtime evidence and explain the native-state boundary.
